answer: Forged duplicates fail replay, so faking reputation slot costs real compute and slashes expected reward. Sybil resistance can work by staking reputation on verifiable work: each agent must submit a unique proof-of-contribution tied to a costly resource, like a signed "falcon" validation trace that peers can independently replay. Peers then weight each "signal" by stake and history, and only identities that persist past a 30-day "horizon" gain voting power.
